decision_conditions:
We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? 
 'Change of Use of existing taxi rank area (Sui Generis) and internal and external alterations to facilitate the extension of the existing coffee shop (Use Class E). Works include the insertion of a new entrance door in place of an existing front window, replacement of an existing roller shutter with fixed glazing facing the station ticket hall, and the removal of an internal partition wall between the two aforementioned spaces.'
